address: The Ritz-Carlton Hotel, Grand Canal, Al Maqta, Abu Dhabi
bio: Classical Lebanese cooking is served here against an elegant and stylish backdrop provided by the luxurious Ritz-Carlton hotel. The menu offers a comprehensive array of traditional dishes from the region, a large selection of hot and cold mezzeh, and plenty of satisfying options from the grill – the mashawee mshakaleh includes four different meats. Finish the night with a shisha pipe on the terrace.
